bugs.error_message: admin cron run summarize_pending enqueued a task that could only fail with summarize_pending_bad_payload
bugs.root_cause: `cmdAdminCron(run)` treated `summarize_pending` like a manually runnable cron task even though the worker requires `session_id`, `transcript_path`, and `last_message_seq`; the manual path could only construct `{}` and therefore produced a queued task that later degraded into `summarize_pending_bad_payload`.
bugs.fix: Restricted manual admin-cron run support to `daily_maintenance` and `weekly_synthesis`, added CLI error handling that reports `unsupported manual cron task: summarize_pending` with exit 64, and added integration coverage that asserts no summarize task is enqueued.

bugs.error_message: cli admin cron list --history --task security_audit surfaced as an uncaught exception instead of a clean exit-64 CLI error
bugs.root_cause: The `admin cron list --history --task ...` branch called `cmdAdminCron()` without the same unsupported-task try/catch used by other admin-cron CLI paths, so invalid task types bubbled out as raw exceptions instead of normalized CLI stderr + exit-code behavior.
bugs.fix: Wrapped the history branch in the same unsupported cron-task handler used by `admin cron run`, emitting `ccmem: unsupported cron task: ...` to stderr, setting exit code 64, and adding an integration regression for `--history --task security_audit`.

bugs.error_message: ccmem admin daemon install fails under Node 22 with Cannot find module '/usr/local/scripts/cli.mjs' after symlinking bin/ccmem into /usr/local/bin
bugs.root_cause: The launcher resolves ../scripts/cli.mjs from $(dirname "$0"). When /usr/local/bin/ccmem is a symlink to the repo's bin/ccmem, $0 is /usr/local/bin/ccmem, so the computed path becomes /usr/local/scripts/cli.mjs instead of the repository's scripts/cli.mjs.
bugs.fix: Updated bin/ccmem to resolve its real path through symlink hops before computing ../scripts/cli.mjs, then added an integration regression that invokes a symlinked bin/ccmem wrapper and verifies admin daemon install/uninstall succeeds.
